missing.why: the guide prints no single-game tackles record list: the INDIVIDUAL RECORDS pages (379-390) have no tackles box, pp. 370-374 give only CAREER and SEASON TACKLES (SINCE 1974), p378 prints one tackles leader per season, and a regex search of the whole guide for 'most tackles', 'tackles, game' and 'tackles in a game' finds only those pages (pp. 403-410 'Top Performances' cover 100-yard rushing, 300-yard passing and 100-yard receiving games only)

notes: Source: 2026 Tennessee Titans Media Guide (IA item tennessee-titans-2026-media-guide-2026-08-13), RECORDS section pp. 368-411; the PDF page number equals the printed page number (checked on the page footers). Ranked 'ALL-TIME TEAM LEADERS BY CATEGORY' tables are on pp. 370-374 (top 20 for rushing, passing and receiving yards and receptions; 21/17 rows for interceptions; 10 for tackles; 14/11 for sacks) and boxed 'INDIVIDUAL RECORDS' lists on pp. 379-390 (Career/Season/Game sub-lists).

Franchise scope: the lists are the whole franchise record, including the Houston Oilers years (1960 on, e.g. Charlie Hennigan 1960-66, Earl Campbell 1978-84, Elvin Bethea 1968-83, Warren Moon 1984-93, Jim Norton 1960-68) and the Tennessee Oilers/Titans years; p2 prints the club record as 'TITANS/OILERS ALL-TIME RECORD'. Opponent games ('Game, Opponent'), 'Season, Rookie' lists, NFL-record rows, and playoff records (pp. 608-614) are not used.

through_season is 2025: the lists contain 2025 entries (Cam Ward 2025, Tony Pollard 2024-25, Jeffery Simmons 2019-25, Chig Okonkwo 2022-25, Joey Slye 2025 on p380) and the guide has a '2025 REVIEW' (pp. 316-367) and year-by-year stats 1960-2025 (p3 table of contents).

Which list was used: where the guide prints a list ranked by the exact stat it is kind=list. Yards, receptions, interceptions, tackles and sacks use the ranked pp. 370-374 tables (they print more rows and carry rank numbers); touchdown lists (rushing, passing, receiving) and all game lists come from the INDIVIDUAL RECORDS pages. Because those boxes print no rank numbers, rank = printed position and tied values share the lowest rank (1,1,3 style); tie=true marks every tied row. The ranked tables print rank numbers only on the first row of a tie; ties are marked the same way.

The ranked tables carry TD columns (rushing, passing, receiving), but exact touchdown lists exist, so no kind=column lists are needed. Position tags printed after a name ((QB), (TE), (RB)) and the 'rookie season' italics are not in the name field; raw keeps the tags.

Internal inconsistencies inside the guide (the conflicting row is flagged uncertain where it is in a list; values are as printed in the list used): Dan Pastorini career passing yards 16,864 (p370) vs 16,846 (p383); Ken Burrough career receiving yards 6,906 (p371 receiving-yards table) vs 6,907 (p371 receptions table and p385); Charlie Hennigan 1964 receiving yards 1,546 (p369, p371) vs 1,561 (p385); Ray Childress career sacks 75.5 (p374) vs 74.5 (p390); George Blanda 1964 passing yards 3,287 (p370) vs 3,282 (p374 year-by-year); the p390 season-sacks box omits Elvin Bethea 1976 (14.5) which p374 lists.

Spelling variants between pages (each list uses the spelling printed on its own page): Fred Glick (pp. 369, 373) / Freddy Glick (p389); Ed Hussmann (p390) / Ed Husmann (p369); Charley Frazier (p371) / Charles Frazier (p385).

The prints '1996-03' (two-digit end years) are used on pp. 370-374 and '1996-2003' on pp. 379-390; both are kept as printed in years. The rank number for Gifford Nielsen (19th) is not printed in the p370 career passing table; it is shown as rank 19 because the 18th and 20th rows are numbered and his 3,255 sits between them.

Game lists: 'years' holds the printed date reformatted to M/D/YYYY (two-digit years 60-99 read as 19xx, 00-59 as 20xx; the franchise started in 1960) plus the printed opponent ('@' written as 'at'); raw keeps the printed text exactly. A '*' after a value (7* on p384) is the guide's 'Tied for NFL record' mark.

Game receiving TDs and game interceptions: the guide prints only one aggregate line for each (3 TD, 18 times, last by DeAndre Hopkins; 3 INT, nine players, last by Kevin Byard). Each is kept as a single flagged row (tie and uncertain) so the 3-count record is not lost; no other holder is named in the guide, so do not treat the one row as the sole record holder.

Tackles: career and season lists exist (p373, since 1974); there is no single-game tackles list (listed under missing). The tackle 'No' column is total tackles: the p378 year-by-year table's Total column (Solo + Assist) matches the p373 season values.
Sacks: the guide's own footnotes (p374 and p390) say sacks became official only in 1982, so sacks before 1982 (for example Elvin Bethea 1968-83, Ed Hussmann 1962) are unofficial.

Verification: every digit used was read from 220-dpi crops of the page pictures (not only OCR). Independent machine checks: (1) the Internet Archive OCR text of the same page contains every number used (only a few printed averages that the IA OCR garbled were confirmed on the crops alone) and matches name, years and first values for 235 ranked-table rows; (2) a separate Tesseract run on 250-dpi renders matches 314 of the 327 rows verbatim, and the other 13 differ only by OCR noise ('81t' read as '8it', a date wrapped onto the next line). Cross-page agreement inside the guide (values equal where a stat is printed twice): career/season rushing yards, season passing yards, career and season receptions, career rushing/passing/receiving touchdown counts versus the TD columns, career and season interceptions, season sacks; the exceptions are the conflicts listed in the inconsistencies note above.
